papers.tldr: TL;DR: CASEは、感情混乱を局所的に捉え、再利用可能なペア特有のEmotionSkillsを用いることで、マルチモーダル感情認識（MER）の精度を向上させる新しいエージェントスキルフレームワークです。実験により、CASEはQwen3-VL-8BのCA-MERベンチマークで精度を46.80%から59.13%に改善し、さまざまなMLLMにおいて効果的であることが示されました。

papers.title: PathJev: Decision-Native Vision-Language Modelling for Histopathology
papers.summary: Vision-language models used for decisions in histopathology rarely return calibrated probabilities over the candidates a user cares about. Decision-native models write a question and a candidate set chosen at run time into the input and return a normalised distribution from a small decision head in one forward pass. We build PathJev-P, a decision-native model for histopathology: MedGemma-1.5-4B with LoRA adapters and a decision head, trained on 40,000 patch states from three public collections whose expert labels are turned into typed questions with organ-specific candidate sets and a "none of these" option. In a comparison over 3 seeds with an analysis plan fixed before testing, on test sets without documented overlap with the training data of the backbone, PathJev-P is more accurate than a generative model trained with the same backbone, data and selection rule, the zero-shot pathology model CONCH and a general medical decision model (balanced accuracy 0.541 against 0.492, 0.345 and 0.213); its advantage over the generative model comes from two organs absent from training. The calibration advantage depends on how the generative model's probabilities are read out. With the summed candidate log-likelihood used in previous work, PathJev-P has the lower calibration error (ECE 0.204 against 0.279); with a length-normalised read-out of the same generative model, examined post hoc, the two have similar mean calibration error (0.201) and the generative model is better calibrated on the unseen organs, where PathJev-P remains over-confident. A supervised linear probe on a pathology foundation model is better calibrated in every setting. In a qualitative whole-slide demonstration, PathJev-P labels unsupervised tissue clusters with abstention and separates carcinoma from other tissue while running the model on a fraction of the tiles.
papers.tldr: PathJev-Pは、ヒストパソロジーに特化したデシジョンネイティブなビジョン-ランゲージモデルで、40,000のパッチ状態を用いて訓練され、他のモデルに比べて高い精度と良好なキャリブレーションを実現しています。特に、訓練データに含まれない臓器に対しても優れた性能を発揮し、質的なデモでは無監督の組織クラスタを適切にラベル付けしています。

papers.title: CauProphet: Teaching Agents to Develop Causal Cognition like Humans
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly support long-horizon tasks by leveraging external memory and past experience. However, existing agents mainly retrieve records or summaries, lacking the ability to form and refine causal understanding of the world. Inspired by human causal cognition, we introduce CauProphet, an agent that develops and updates causal knowledge within its Causal Cognition. For each task, CauProphet combines relevant knowledge in Causal Cognition with current evidence to construct a Causal Belief, a structured belief capturing causal factors and the effects of possible actions. It uses this belief for decision-making and continuously updates both the belief and Causal Cognition as new observations emerge, enabling causal knowledge that persists beyond individual experiences. Evaluations demonstrate that CauProphet progressively acquires causal knowledge and transfers it to future decision-making. In financial research, CauProphet leverages prior discoveries to improve downstream analyses and outperforms all baselines in mean rank correlation with next-day returns, achieving a 25.4% improvement over a baseline agent. It also improves prediction accuracy from 21.3% to 28.6% in dynamic real-world settings. Further experiments validate its ability to perform reliable causal analysis and action selection across scientific and everyday tasks, demonstrating the potential of causal experience learning for next-generation LLM agents.
papers.tldr: CauProphetは、因果認知を発展させるエージェントで、過去の経験と外部メモリを活用して因果関係を理解し、意思決定に役立てる。金融研究においては、従来のエージェントよりも優れた予測精度を示し、因果分析と行動選択の信頼性を向上させることが実証された。
